notes.title: 🐾 Kittens and Yarn in the Cat Awareness Feline Sale! 🐾
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40656337/5df831342c5809dfc04184ba750901ebc71bf3dd.png[/img]

Our game Kittens and Yarn is now part of the Cat Awareness Feline Sale! Don't miss out on the cutest adventure and grab it at a special discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1644840/Kittens_and_Yarn/

[h2]ːsteamthisː Take advantage of the discount now! ːsteamthisː[/h2]

Lots of cuteness and mess! That's exactly what you get for having several kittens at home.

Kittens and Yarn is a cute and minimalist puzzle game where it's up to you to untangle the yarns by simply swapping the pieces.

notes.title: Button to reset level and button to reset all game data
notes.content:
I just released an update, which now has a button inside the level that is able to reset the level. Also, there is an option to reset the data of the whole game in the settings menu.

Thank you very much to everyone who gave some feedback. You guys are awesome!

Thanks!
